name: Direction Bin Method for Multiple Scattering
definition: A method for computing higher-order (multiple) scattering in volume rendering by discretizing the sphere of directions into bins arranged on the exterior faces of a 3D grid of cubes, solving for flux transfer between these bins.
summary: The Direction Bin Method computes multiple scattering in volume rendering by discretizing directions into bins on a 3D grid's exterior faces to efficiently capture higher-order scattering effects.
